headline: Recommended final passage of $345,000 PFAS landfill borrowing, $150,000 school transfer, and $790,387 trust fund creation, all 7-0.
summary: The committee recommended final passage of three resolutions by 7-0 roll call votes: borrowing $345,000 for the Four Hills Landfill PFAS/leachate pilot project, transferring $150,000 from the school department to the Food Services Fund, and creating three expendable trust funds funded by a $790,387 transfer from prior year escrows. A communication from the Director of Public Works was accepted and placed on file.
decisions: Accepted a communication from Lisa Fauteux, Director of Public Works, regarding a referral from the Board of Aldermen, and placed it on file.

Recommended final passage of R-26-057, approving borrowing of an additional $345,000 from the Clean Water State Revolving Fund for the Four Hills Landfill PFAS/leachate removal pilot project, by a 7-0 roll call vote.
Recommended final passage of R-26-065, transferring $150,000 from Department 191 School Account 71221 to the Food Services Fund, by a 7-0 roll call vote.
Recommended final passage of R-26-074, creating three new expendable trust funds and transferring $790,387 from prior year escrows, by a 7-0 roll call vote.
